title: Pregnancy Recipes: Iron-and-Folate Bowls You Can Cook in 30 Minutes
excerpt: Three tasty recipes pairing heme/non-heme iron with vitamin C — Vietnamese-inspired bowls with clear amounts and food-safety notes.
content:
## Introduction
During pregnancy, it's essential to consume enough iron and folate to ensure the health of both mother and baby. Iron helps create red blood cells, while folate supports the development of the fetus. However, many pregnant women struggle to find recipes rich in iron and folate. In this article, we'll introduce three delicious and iron-rich recipes that can be cooked in under 30 minutes.

## Recipe 1: Grilled Chicken and Vegetable Bowl
This recipe combines grilled chicken (rich in heme iron) with vitamin C-rich vegetables like bell peppers, carrots, and cilantro. To cook, you'll need:
- 120g grilled chicken
- 1 cup cooked white rice
- 1/2 cup sliced bell peppers
- 1/2 cup sliced carrots
- 1/4 cup chopped cilantro
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- Salt and pepper to taste

Cook the white rice according to the package instructions. Grill the chicken in the oven at 200°C for 20 minutes. Sauté the bell peppers, carrots, and cilantro in olive oil until the vegetables are tender. Mix all the ingredients together and season with salt and pepper to taste.

## Recipe 2: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry with Lemon
This recipe combines beef stir-fry (rich in heme iron) with broccoli rich in vitamin C and lemon. To cook, you'll need:
- 120g beef stir-fry
- 1 cup cooked white rice
- 1 cup broccoli florets
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 1 tablespoon freshly squeezed lemon juice
- Salt and pepper to taste

Cook the white rice according to the package instructions. Stir-fry the beef in olive oil until it's cooked through. Add the broccoli florets and stir-fry until they're tender. Squeeze the lemon juice over the top and season with salt and pepper to taste. Mix all the ingredients together.

## Recipe 3: Vegetarian Red Bean and Vegetable Bowl
This recipe combines cooked red beans (rich in non-heme iron) with vitamin C-rich vegetables like carrots, bell peppers, and cilantro. To cook, you'll need:
- 1 cup cooked red beans
- 1 cup cooked white rice
- 1/2 cup sliced carrots
- 1/2 cup sliced bell peppers
- 1/4 cup chopped cilantro
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- Salt and pepper to taste

Cook the white rice according to the package instructions. Cook the red beans in water until they're tender. Sauté the carrots, bell peppers, and cilantro in olive oil until the vegetables are tender. Mix all the ingredients together and season with salt and pepper to taste.

## Food Safety Notes
During pregnancy, it's crucial to ensure food safety. Remember the following guidelines:
- Cook meat, fish, and eggs before eating.
- Avoid eating raw or undercooked food.
- Wash your hands before preparing and eating food.
- Keep food at a safe temperature.

## Conclusion
These three recipes provide a rich source of iron and folate, helping pregnant women ensure their health and the health of their baby. Remember to follow the food safety guidelines to ensure the health of your entire family. To learn more about iron-rich recipes, you can visit our [pregnancy meal planner](/blog/pregnancy-meal-planner) page.
